The *Vitakkattika* ("The Triad 'Thought-conception, etc.'") constitutes section 7.6 of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the final book of the canonical Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Catalog; SuttaCentral; Nyanatiloka 2007]. Within the analytical architecture of the *Paṭṭhāna*, it is classified as the sixth triad chapter among the twenty-two primary matrix triads (*tika*) of the Abhidhamma classification system [Nyanatiloka 2007].

No external or cross-language parallels are recorded for this text in SuttaCentral or DharmaNexus [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, computational analysis by DharmaNexus indicates extensive internal text reuse across the *Paṭṭhāna*, detecting 87 matching passages shared with 22 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The largest concentration of text sharing occurs with other structural treatments of the *vitakka* triad, primarily *Vitakkattika* (*Patthana* 1.7; 29 matches, 6,742 characters, with the longest continuous alignment covering §1.1–3.1 to §182.1_2–185.1), *Vitakkattika* (*Patthana* 13.6; 4 matches), and *Vitakkattika* (*Patthana* 19.6; 2 matches) [DharmaNexus]. It also exhibits significant text-reuse alignments with combined triad and dyad chapters, notably *Tika Hetuduka* (*Patthana* 4.1; 12 matches, 2,323 characters) and *Tika Kusalattika* (*Patthana* 5.2; 4 matches), as well as neighboring chapters in Book 7 such as *Upādinnattika* (*Patthana* 7.4) and *Vipākattika* (*Patthana* 7.3) [DharmaNexus].
